title: 第17章 又想吃肉了第18章 打猎冲突
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 夜深了。
王大山刚刚收功，突然听到一道细微的响声。
“有人？”
他眼神一凝，翻身下床。
拿起胎铁大弓，赤着脚，悄无声息地走到了门后。
透过门缝，能隐约看到一个纤细的身影。
正站在寒风中，犹豫不决，似乎想敲门，手抬起来又放下了。
“这是，又想了……”
王大山嘴角勾起一抹玩味的笑容。
他猛地一把拉开了房门。
房门开了，林柔措不及防之下，差点栽倒进王大山的怀中！
她的眼神有些躲闪，脸上迅速飞起两团红晕。
“大……大哥……你……你还没睡啊？”
林柔有些羞涩。
“我当然没睡。”
王大山靠在门框上，居高临下地看着她。
目光肆无忌惮地在她身上扫了两眼。
“倒是弟妹你，这么晚了不在屋里陪着我这废物弟弟。”
“跑到这破茅草屋，来干什么？”
说着。
王大山往前逼近了一步，语气带着几分戏谑。
“怎么？”
“又饿了？又想吃肉了？”
听到吃肉两个字，林柔的身子明显颤了一下。
她咬着嘴唇，低着头，不敢看王大山的眼睛。
之前吃到的肉，彻底勾起了她的馋虫。
再加上王锦程就是个没用的东西，整天除了抱怨就是睡觉。
看着眼前强壮如山的王大山。
林柔的心跳得厉害。
“我……我是来……”
她支支吾吾半天，也没说出个所以然来。
王大山却懒得听她编借口。
他现在火气正旺，送上门的肉，哪有不吃的道理？
content_en:
It's late at night.
Wang Dashan had just finished his work when he suddenly heard a subtle sound.
"Is there anyone?"
His eyes narrowed and he got out of bed.
Picking up the tire-iron bow, he quietly walked behind the door with his bare feet.
Through the crack in the door, a slender figure can be vaguely seen.
He was standing in the cold wind, hesitating, as if he wanted to knock on the door, raising his hand and putting it down again.
"This is, I thought about it again..."
A playful smile appeared on Wang Dashan's lips.
He yanked open the door.
The door opened, and Lin Rou was caught off guard and almost fell into Wang Dashan's arms!
Her eyes were a little evasive, and two blushes quickly appeared on her face.
"Big...brother...you...you haven't slept yet?"
Lin Rou was a little shy.
"Of course I didn't sleep."
Wang Dashan leaned against the door frame and looked at her condescendingly.
His eyes swept over her body unscrupulously.
"It's my fault, sister-in-law, that you're not in the house with my good-for-nothing brother at this late hour."
"What are you doing here in this shabby thatched hut?"
Said.
Wang Dashan took a step closer, his tone a bit joking.
"What?"
"Are you hungry again? Want to eat meat again?"
…
"Ah."
Lin Rou's body visibly trembled when she heard the word "eat meat."
She bit her lip and lowered her head, not daring to look into Wang Dashan's eyes.
The meat she ate before completely aroused her greed.
In addition, Wang Jincheng is useless. He only complains and sleeps all day long.
Looking at Wang Dashan who is as strong as a mountain in front of him.
Lin Rou's heart beat violently.
"I...I'm here..."
She hesitated for a long time, but didn't give a clear answer.
Wang Dashan was too lazy to listen to her excuses.
He is very angry now. How can he not eat the meat that is delivered to his door?
